column3: “The sons of” is rendered “the son of” three times.
“Slave” is rendered “servant,” and “to a wife” as “in marriage.”
“The sons of Mareshah” is rendered “his son was Mareshah”; the Hebrew is difficult.
The Hebrew has a masculine verb (“he bore”); NASB renders “bore.”
NASB divides the verse as “These were the sons of Caleb. The sons of Hur …”; the Hebrew reads “the sons of Caleb, son of Hur.”
“Clans of the Sophrites” is rendered “families of scribes.”
